stemMd:
One feature of the design deserves special ______ its adjustable supports allow objects of several sizes to be displayed without replacing the entire frame.

Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?
explanationMd: The second clause explains the feature that deserves attention. A colon can follow the complete first clause and introduce that explanation.

distractorRationale.b: A comma alone would splice two independent clauses.
distractorRationale.c: The two independent clauses need a boundary.
distractorRationale.d: The colon after the coordinating conjunction and has no complete preceding clause to introduce its explanation.
